name: TATA box
note: core promoter element in a minority of promoters

name: DRE
note: DREF binding site in fly core promoters

name: GAGA element
note: GAGA factor sites upstream of fly promoters

name: GC box (Sp1)
note: Sp1 binding site in CpG-island promoters

name: CCAAT box
note: NF-Y binding site upstream of eukaryotic promoters

name: CpG run
note: CpG islands mark most human promoters

name: Telo box
note: internal telomeric repeat in plant promoters

name: Shine-Dalgarno
note: ribosome binding site upstream of start codons (inside these windows)

name: Sm site
note: Sm protein binding site of spliceosomal snRNAs

name: AP-1 site
note: Jun/Fos binding site, common in enhancers
